about_the_game:
Find 500 hidden cats across five unique underwater maps and bring them to life by coloring them by numbers! Dive deep into the ocean and get ready to find hundreds of adorable cats in hiding! From hand-drawn coral reefs and sunken ships to glowing caves and mossy ruins, explore 5 beautifully illustrated maps with 500 cats waiting to be discovered.

🎨 Once you've found them, color each scene using the paint-by-numbers system only. Let the relaxing colors wash over you as you breathe life into every map!

✨ Features:

🌊 5 unique underwater maps

🔍 500 hidden cats

🎨 Paint-by-numbers coloring only

🧘‍♀️ Stress-free gameplay

🎧 A special underwater-themed radio

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Play duo with a friend online
